sql: SELECT 'new_rev' k, r.status||' activated_at='||coalesce(r.activated_at::text,'NULL') v FROM platform_revisions r WHERE r.id=11 UNION ALL SELECT 'predecessor', r.status||' retired_at='||coalesce(r.retired_at::text,'NULL') FROM platform_revisions r JOIN platform_components c ON c.id=r.component_id WHERE c.key='MARKET_TAXONOMY' AND r.version='coverage_2026_08_13' UNION ALL SELECT 'old_epoch_9', 'ended_at='||coalesce(ended_at::text,'NULL') FROM experiment_epochs WHERE id=9 UNION ALL SELECT 'new_epoch_10', 'started_at='||started_at::text||' ended_at='||coalesce(ended_at::text,'NULL')||' impact_class='||coalesce(impact_class,'-') FROM experiment_epochs WHERE id=10 UNION ALL SELECT 'new_epoch_snapshot_pins', c.key||':'||r.version FROM experiment_epochs e JOIN platform_snapshot_items i ON i.snapshot_id=e.platform_snapshot_id JOIN platform_revisions r ON r.id=i.revision_id JOIN platform_components c ON c.id=r.component_id WHERE e.id=10 AND c.key='MARKET_TAXONOMY' UNION ALL SELECT 'i2_record', status||' resulting_epoch_id='||coalesce(resulting_epoch_id::text,'NULL') FROM platform_impact_actions WHERE revision_id=11 AND impact_class='I2' UNION ALL SELECT 'epoch10_experiment', e.key FROM experiment_epochs ep JOIN experiment_versions v ON v.id=ep.version_id JOIN experiments e ON e.id=v.experiment_id WHERE ep.id=10
